scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), cp = require('child_process'); function walk(d) { fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f => { const p = path.join(d, f); if (fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p); else if (p.endsWith('.js')) { cp.execSync('node --check ' + p); } }); } walk('src'); console.log('All backend JavaScript files passed syntax verification.');"
